reviews.text:
Hello Everyone
I had a privilege to meet a divine soul and Akashik reader Rekha Bala Ji, for my session reading . I saw her in a few YouTube broadcasts and found her simple , honest and dedicated in her speach and got connected at once … Her vision was clear and focused… Her consideration to adjust me in her busy schedule was kind , as per my request.. She made me very comfortable within minutes, as getting reading for self , it’s a delicate issue and I was a bit nervous , But ….she was fresh , full of positive energy..and made me settle .. My questions were complicated, but she wasn’t in a hurry as she wanted get deep in cause as my health issues were very alarming… The guidance was accurate and meaningful.. I could see through problems clearly and guidance was clear and workable .. She was getting answers so fast that I was a bit surprised and happy .. She is full of patience, warmth and ready to help attitude… A motivator, a professional with deep experience in her work .. A few questions are again lined up and requesting her for another session … I feel a reader with such qualities wins confidence of client .. Thanks mam for your immense support and correct guidance.. My best wishes and blessings…🙏🏼. VIVEK MALHOTRA

reviews.name: Rohit malik
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful and deeply insightful experience with Rekha Bala during my Akashic Records reading. Her ability to connect at a deeper level and identify my blockages and the areas that were affecting me was truly remarkable.

What stood out for me was the clarity and accuracy with which she was able to identify certain patterns and “black spots” through her intuitive/third-eye reading. Many of the things she pointed out made me reflect deeply on my experiences and helped me understand certain aspects of my life from a completely different perspective.

She was patient and very professional throughout the session and best thing was she actually gave a lot of time and was not at all in hurry. She created a comfortable space where I could openly explore things that I had been carrying with me, and her guidance gave me a greater sense of awareness and direction.

I am genuinely grateful for the time, energy, and insight she shared with me. I would definitely recommend Rekha Bala to anyone who is looking for deeper self-understanding, spiritual guidance, and clarity about their personal blockages.

Thank you, Rekha, for such a meaningful and enlightening experience!

reviews.name: Shikha Prasad
reviews.text:
Hello Mam 🕉️ A heartfelt thank you to Rekha Bala and Akashic Reading 🙏🏻

I was going through a very confusing time where I kept seeing my grandparents or ancestors in my dreams, but I couldn’t understand what they were trying to tell me. It felt very emotional to me.

Not only did she give me remedies, but through her reading I was also able to connect with my ancestors—my Papa, my Dadi, and my Badi Nani. It felt so comforting, and carried the same emotions I used to feel with them 🥹🤗

Also At the same time, I felt like I was going through a phase where nothing was moving forward, like my growth was stuck.... She helped me understand everything with so much calmness and clarity !

And now, because of her GUIDANCE one major thing that was stuck in my career has finally started moving, and it has lifted a huge weight off me. I am truly so grateful for that MAM

I felt heard, understood, and supported throughout the session.

Grateful for her guidance and this experience Mam

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with Rekha ji during my recent Akashic reading session. She has a very calm and comforting presence, which made it easy to open up and ask questions. Her readings felt accurate and resonated with my situation.

What I appreciated the most was that she suggested simple home remedies instead of recommending expensive solutions. She genuinely focuses on helping rather than selling anything.

She also made sure every one of my questions was answered patiently without rushing through the session. It was truly a pleasant experience talking to her, and I left feeling much more clear and positive. I would definitely recommend Rekha ji to anyone looking for a thoughtful and sincere Akashic reading.
